problem:
A store collected data about its profits (in thousands of dollars) for the first five months since opening. This data is shown below.

| Month $(x)$ | **$1$** | **$2$** | **$3$** | **$4$** | **$5$** |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Profit $(y)$ | $8.3$ | $5.1$ | $10.9$ | $10.7$ | $9.5$ |

Find the line of the form $y={\beta }_{0}+{\beta }_{1}x$ that best fits the data above. According to the model, what will be the profit in the $6$th month, assuming that the trend continues?

*Hint: You can use the fact that*

$$
({X}^{T}\,X)^{-1}=\frac{1}{10}[\begin{aligned}11 & -3 \\ -3 & 1\end{aligned}],\,{X}^{T}y=[\begin{aligned}44.5 \\ 141.5\end{aligned}],
$$

*where $X$ is the corresponding design matrix and $y$ is the observation vector.*
